step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram displays an ingestion and analytics pipeline for Lotte ON's BI platform. On the left are source databases (Traffic DB, DynamoDB, RDS, Redshift, ElasticSearch) ingesting into an S3 Data Lake. An On-Prem DW feeds into AWS Glue along with scripts from an S3 bucket. AWS Glue interacts bi-directionally with the Data Lake for processing and transforms, and interacts bi-directionally with Redshift. Redshift delivers processed data to a BI application hosted on EC2.
